exercises.why: **ушёл** — уйти́ (perfective): to leave, to depart, to go (away) (by foot); to escape, to evade; (colloquial) to resign, to retire; to be lost. Wiktionary: у- + -йти́.

exercises.q: What does у- add in улете́ть (“to fly away, to depart (by flying)”)?
options: completing the action of the base verb, bringing it to a result or to exhaustive fullness
covering the object completely with something by the action of the base verb
moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb
keeping in the state the base verb names
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists улете́ть under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to steal anything that can move by itself (vehicle, vessel, cattle, etc)
to leave, to depart, to go (away) (by foot)
to fly away, to depart (by flying)
to go away, to drive off, to leave, to depart (by conveyance)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: угна́ть — to steal anything that can move by itself (vehicle, vessel, cattle, etc); уйти́ — to leave, to depart, to go (away) (by foot); улете́ть — to fly away, to depart (by flying); уе́хать — to go away, to drive off, to leave, to depart (by conveyance).
